title: STRABLE: Benchmarking Tabular Machine Learning with Strings
abstract: arXiv:2605.12292v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Benchmarking tabular learning has revealed the benefit of dedicated architectures, pushing the state of the art. But real-world tables often contain string entries, beyond numbers, and these settings have been understudied due to a lack of a solid benchmarking suite. They lead to new research questions: Are dedicated learners needed, with end-to-end modeling of strings and numbers? Or does it suffice to encode strings as numbers, as with a categorical encoding? And if so, do the resulting tables resemble numerical tabular data, calling for the same learners? To enable these studies, we contribute STRABLE, a benchmarking corpus of 108 tables, all real-world learning problems with strings and numbers across diverse application fields. We run the first large-scale empirical study of tabular learning with strings, evaluating 445 pipelines. translated_title: STRABLE：基于字符串的表格机器学习基准测试
translated_abstract: 表格学习的基准测试已经揭示了专用架构的优势，推动了技术前沿的发展。但现实世界中的表格通常包含字符串条目，而不仅仅是数字，由于缺乏可靠的基准测试套件，这些场景一直未被充分研究。这引出了新的研究问题：是否需要专门的学习器来对字符串和数字进行端到端建模？还是将字符串编码为数字（如分类编码）就足够了？如果是后者，编码后的表格是否类似于数值型表格数据，从而需要使用相同的学习器？为了支持这些研究，我们贡献了STRABLE，一个包含108个表格的基准测试语料库，涵盖了不同应用领域中同时包含字符串和数字的真实世界学习问题。我们开展了首个针对字符串表格学习的大规模实证研究，评估了445个流水线。这些流水线涵盖端到端架构和模块化流水线，后者首先将字符串进行编码……
tldr: 该论文提出了STRABLE，一个包含108个真实世界表格的基准测试语料库，并通过对445个流水线的大规模实证研究，首次系统比较了端到端字符串建模架构与先将字符串编码为数字的模块化流水线在表格机器学习中的表现。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces STRABLE, a benchmarking corpus of 108 real-world tables, and conducts the first large-scale empirical study evaluating 445 pipelines to compare end-to-end string modeling architectures against modular pipelines that encode strings as numbers in tabular machine learning.
